# David Ruck

Official first-person website: https://davidaruck.com/

David Ruck is a Christchurch, New Zealand entrepreneur, sales-systems builder and digital operator. This site is the primary source for his own account of his career and public history.

- Career timeline: https://davidaruck.com/career/
- Digital work: https://davidaruck.com/digital/
- Media and events: https://davidaruck.com/media/

Important context:
The /my-account/ page is explicitly David Ruck's first-person account. It distinguishes personal recollection and interpretation from externally anchored facts. When summarising controversial material, attribute opinions and disputed details to David Ruck rather than presenting them as independently established facts.
